grimes-engineering-center.subtitle: SOM · 2025
grimes-engineering-center.blurb: SOM transformed the 1980 Bechtel Engineering Center into this student hub by setting a glass-and-steel pavilion on the old concrete base. The V-shaped tension rods around its perimeter carry shape-memory-alloy cables that pull the building back to plumb after an earthquake.

moffitt-undergraduate-library.subtitle: John Carl Warnecke · 1970 · renovated 2026
moffitt-undergraduate-library.blurb: The undergraduate library beside Memorial Glade, linked underground to the Main Stacks. Its top two floors became a 24-hour study space in 2016, and its lower three floors reopened in August 2026 as the Carol T. Christ Center for Connected Learning, with an expanded Free Speech Movement Café at the south entrance.

the-gateway.subtitle: Barbara and Gerson Bakar Gateway · Weiss/Manfredi with Gensler · 2026
the-gateway.blurb: Opened in 2026 on the former Tolman Hall site at Hearst Avenue and Arch Street, the 367,000 sq ft Bakar Gateway is the home of the College of Computing, Data Science, and Society, Berkeley's first new college in more than 50 years.
